label: Commission
definition: The Commission's duty to develop Union expertise and capabilities in the field of AI through the AI Office.
source_quote: The Commission shall develop Union expertise and capabilities in the field of AI through the AI Office.

label: Member States
definition: The Member States' duty to facilitate the tasks entrusted to the AI Office, as reflected in this Regulation.
source_quote: Member States shall facilitate the tasks entrusted to the AI Office, as reflected in this Regulation.
